description: Tutorial lesson T4 (Dakka Time), mouse player path: boot from the tutorial_t4_shoot fixture -> select the Boyz as shooter by clicking their token on the board -> aim the Slugga by clicking its weapon row then the Witchseekers -> aim the rest with the 'All -> Witchseekers' quick-assign button (the lesson clears boot.auto_assign_single_target, so the player performs the assignment the lesson teaches) -> Confirm (3 weapons) -> Fast Roll All in the resolution dock -> Done on each defender save results card (tolerant: pressed only while visible) -> Complete Shooting -> open the Dice Log tab on the left panel and read the rolls that were just made (this step moved here from T1, where it fired before any dice existed) -> end the phase with the big phase button -> lesson summary -> back to menu.

steps.comment: a Boyz model - board-token path selects the unit as shooter
the lesson clears boot.auto_assign_single_target, so picking the shooter leaves every gun unaimed and the player has an assign step to do

steps.equals: (Click to Select)|(Click to Select)|(Click to Select)
steps.comment: nothing auto-assigned
real click on the Slugga row - step 'aim_first_gun' teaches pick-a-gun-then-click-the-enemy
click the target on the board - assigns the selected weapon

the 'All → Witchseekers' quick-assign button the 'aim_da_rest' prompt points at. Addressed by node name because the label carries live range/damage numbers. With auto-assign suppressed this button is shown down to a single eligible target (it is hidden at <2 in normal play, where the sole target is already auto-assigned).

steps.script:
var n := 0
for a in PhaseManager.current_phase_instance.pending_assignments:
	n += 1
return n
steps.comment: all three weapons (Sluggas + the attached Warboss's kombi-weapon and twin sluggas) are now aimed

step 5 must NAME the Confirm button as the thing to press. Main's version of this assertion also required '(Click to Select)' to appear AFTER it, as a re-aim fallback; that clause belongs to the auto-assign flow and this lesson now has the player aim every gun by hand in the two steps above, so the confirm step no longer carries it.
label text carries a live weapon count - use the named node
step 4 explains the hit/wound/save sequence AND points at the ▲▼ re-order arrows
every queue row carries ▲▼ on its right-hand side; stash the firing order to diff after the click
mouse path: ▼ on the first row pushes that weapon one slot later in the firing order
exactly the first two weapons swapped
defender save results card 1 - press Done only while visible
defender save results card 2 (tolerant no-op when absent)
defender save results card 3 (tolerant no-op when absent)
press Complete Shooting when the dock offers it; else clear any straggler Done card
second chance Complete Shooting after a late Done card
the Dice Log step moved here from T1, where it fired before anything had been rolled and opened a blank panel

THE POINT OF THE MOVE: by the time this step is up the shooting rolls are really in the left panel's Dice Log, so the player is being sent to read something that exists. This caught a real bug rather than just passing: Main._ready() built the GameLogPanel AFTER setup_phase_controllers(), so a lesson booting straight into the shooting phase created the ShootingController first and resolve_shared_dice_log() fell back to a throwaway 'DiceLogFallback' label in the right-hand panel — every roll of the lesson went there while this tab stayed empty. The panel is now built before the controllers.
